Shell(git commit -F - <<'EOF' style(admin): full visual overhaul with warm roastery identity Replaces the generic blue admin-tool look with a polished, coffee-forward operations console. No new dependencies, no backend changes — pure CSS + surgical TS edits across 11 files in apps/admin/. Highlights: - Warm roastery palette: copper (#b06b2c) is now the primary brand accent, blue is informational. New --roast-50…800 scale, warm page bg, warm borders/text. Inter + Fraunces loaded from Google Fonts. - Real design system: --shadow-*, --space-*, --t-*, --z-*, --font-* tokens replace the previous ad-hoc values. - Sticky, per-page top bar: copper-accented gradient strip, breadcrumb (Roastery / Section / Page), page title + subtitle, search trigger. - Cmd+K command palette: fuzzy-filtered, section-grouped list of all 20 routes + 2 quick actions (Bag Label, Restock). Arrow keys + Enter + Esc. - Sidebar grouped into 4 collapsible sections (Operations, Catalog & Pricing, Economics, Customer & Marketing) with section labels. Active item gets a 3px copper left bar and tinted bg. - KPI cards redesigned: icon chip, 3px semantic accent strip, value (serif, tabular nums), delta chip, sub-line. Hover lift with --shadow-md. Real loading skeleton during fetch. - New "Today's Roast Queue" section on the overview: compact cards linking to PAID + ROASTING orders. New "Recent Orders" table with status badges. - Toast notification system (success/error/info/warning) replaces every native alert(). confirmModal() replaces native confirm() with a branded dialog. - Empty-state component (icon + headline + body + action) replaces every "No X yet." plain text row. - Skeleton shimmer placeholders for KPIs, table rows, roast-queue cards. - Order Fulfillment page: search input + 8 status pills (All / Pending / Paid / Roasting / Packed / Shipped / Delivered / Cancelled) with live counts, client-side filter, retry button on errors. - Button hierarchy: .btn-primary (copper), .btn-secondary (white + copper-on-hover), .btn-ghost (transparent). Old .btn-admin-action / .btn-table-action kept as aliases so existing call sites still work. - Top-bar "+ Restock" now opens a real modal that calls POST /api/admin/inventory/adjust with a variant dropdown loaded from the inventory API, instead of the old prompt()/alert() pair. - Top bar sticky on desktop and mobile (was only sticky on mobile). - Mobile responsive rules updated for the new top-bar structure; on <=640px the breadcrumb + search + action buttons are hidden, leaving just the hamburger + page title. Visual reference screenshots (taken locally before cleanup): - admin-desktop.png: 1440x900 overview with toast and search trigger - admin-orders.png: 1440x900 with status pills and search bar - admin-palette.png: Cmd+K palette open with section-grouped results - admin-mobile.png: 414x800 mobile with stacked KPI cards and toast Co-authored-by: CommandCodeBot <noreply@commandcode.ai> EOF)
